messages.content: I want to go back to the seven-night Ogunquit rental and price the two Portland nights around it. The single parking space is enough because we will have only the rental SUV. Compare sensible hotels for Friday arrival and Saturday before the flight, then give me the full cost. Do not reserve anything.

Understood. That makes the overnight sequence Friday, July 10 near Portland; Saturday, July 11 through Friday, July 17 at the Ogunquit rental; and Saturday, July 18 back in Portland, checking out Sunday for the 1:25 p.m. flight. I’ll keep the Friday evening outbound, Sunday nonstop home, and the July 11-19 SUV quote fixed while comparing the two hotel nights.
Correct. For Friday, optimize for the late arrival. For Saturday, I would rather be somewhere we can have dinner and walk around than spend the last night at the airport.

For July 10, the strongest airport options are: the Hilton Garden Inn Portland Airport at $246 including taxes, with a 24-hour shuttle and a room with two queen beds; or the Embassy Suites Portland at $281.36 including taxes, also with a 24-hour shuttle, breakfast, and a two-room suite with two doubles plus a sofa bed. Both allow cancellation until July 9. With the 10:52 p.m. landing, the Hilton is the cleaner value for a roughly 11:35 p.m. arrival.
Use the Hilton unless there is some room problem for three people. We do not need a suite for eight hours.

The quoted Hilton room permits three guests and has two queen beds, so there is no occupancy or bedding issue. The $246 total includes room tax, airport shuttle service, and cancellation through 11:59 p.m. local time on July 9. Breakfast and parking after checkout are not included, but neither is needed for the plan.
Good. What are the final-night choices? Keep the Sunday airport timing in view.

Two practical July 18 options stand out. The Hyatt Place Portland-Old Port is $312.84 including taxes for two queens, with breakfast included and cancellation through July 16; valet parking is an additional $40. The Courtyard Portland Downtown/Waterfront is $337.18 including taxes for two queens, with valet parking at $38 and no included breakfast. Both are about 15 minutes from PWM in light Sunday traffic. The Hyatt gives you the better walking location and lower combined cost.
Does the $312.84 already include the valet? I want the totals to be apples to apples.

No. The Hyatt room total is $312.84, and the $40 valet would make that night $352.84. The Courtyard would be $375.18 with its valet. There is also an off-site garage near the Hyatt at a current overnight maximum of $24, but it does not guarantee in-and-out access.
We will arrive, park, and leave once in the morning. Use the garage estimate with the Hyatt. Is the room actually two queens, not a king and sofa bed?

Yes, the selected Hyatt rate is for a two-queen room with a three-guest maximum. Using the nearby garage once overnight brings the final-night estimate to $336.84. The garage charge is paid separately and could change before July, while the $312.84 hotel amount is the quoted cancellable rate.
Now check the rental math. I remember a large nonrefundable first payment, and I do not want that blurred into the hotel cancellation terms.

The Ogunquit rental is $4,799.54 for seven nights, July 11-18, including cleaning, taxes, and platform charges. It has two bedrooms for three guests and one included parking space. The payment schedule is $2,879.72 due at booking and nonrefundable once charged, followed by $1,919.82 due May 11. The Portland hotels have their own refundable cancellation deadlines; they do not change the rental’s terms.
Lay out the complete lodging number with the parking line separate.

Lodging is $5,358.38: $246.00 for the July 10 Hilton, $4,799.54 for the seven-night Ogunquit rental, and $312.84 for the July 18 Hyatt. Add the estimated $24 Old Port garage charge, making lodging plus final-night parking $5,382.38.
And the entire trip using the flights and car already selected?

The complete current estimate is $7,665.74: $1,188 airfare, $240 for six checked bags, $5,358.38 lodging, $24 estimated final-night garage parking, and $855.36 for the midsize SUV. Without the separately paid garage estimate, fixed quoted charges total $7,641.74.
Confirm the car period still fits this version. We are not collecting it Friday night, and I do not want an extra hotel parking charge at the airport.

It fits. The SUV remains Saturday, July 11 at 8:30 a.m. through Sunday, July 19 at 11:00 a.m., billed as nine days at $855.36. Friday night you use the Hilton shuttle, then return to PWM Saturday morning for pickup, so there is no airport-hotel parking charge. The Ogunquit rental includes its one required space. Only the estimated $24 garage on the final night is additional parking.
What time should we leave the Hyatt Sunday? Include fuel, car return, and the 1:25 departure.

Leave the Hyatt around 9:40 a.m. Stop for fuel near the airport, target the rental return by 10:25, and allow about 20 minutes for unloading and the walk or shuttle to the terminal. That should put you inside PWM around 10:45-11:00, leaving roughly 2 hours 25 minutes before the 1:25 p.m. nonstop. Even with moderate traffic or a short fuel delay, the schedule retains useful margin.
That sequence works. Give me one final purchase-review recap, but leave every item unbooked.

Purchase-review plan, entirely unbooked: Friday, July 10, fly ORD-DCA-PWM from 6:05 to 10:52 p.m., use the 24-hour Hilton shuttle, and stay one night in a two-queen room for $246. Saturday, pick up the midsize SUV at PWM at 8:30 a.m., then check into the two-bedroom Ogunquit rental for seven nights, July 11-18. The rental is $4,799.54 with one parking space; $2,879.72 is due at booking and nonrefundable, and $1,919.82 is due May 11. On Saturday, July 18, move to a two-queen room at Hyatt Place Portland-Old Port for $312.84 and budget $24 for the nearby overnight garage. Leave about 9:40 a.m. Sunday, fuel and return the SUV by roughly 10:25-11:00, then take the 1:25 p.m. PWM-ORD nonstop arriving at 3:18 p.m. Airfare and bags are $1,428, lodging is $5,358.38, the nine-day SUV is $855.36, and estimated garage parking is $24. Fixed quoted charges total $7,641.74; the working trip total with garage parking is $7,665.74. Nothing has been reserved or charged.
